seo.description: The need for business capital rarely arrives neatly packaged in a lender application. It arrives as an opportunity, a gap or a decision that cannot wait forever.

hero.headline: BUILT AROUND THE OPERATOR.
hero.subheadline: The need for business capital rarely arrives neatly packaged in a lender application. It arrives as an opportunity, a gap or a decision that cannot wait forever.

content.lead: Traditional product menus can hide the difference between the cash someone asks for and the underlying challenge. A store may need inventory timing; a contractor may need to bridge payroll; an acquisition buyer may need to understand the whole deal.

sections.heading: THE REALITY

sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
sections.body: Moonshine Capital’s published background emphasizes small-business, banking and private-lending experience. Distilled Funding extends that operator-first view into dedicated pages for capital, business problems, industries, acquisition work and useful tools.

sections.heading: YOUR NEXT MOVE
sections.body: The next chapter is a connected network in which each destination has a clear job. Dates, personal founder biography and company milestones must be added only after source approval.
